Cookies · Website notice

Browser storage and external requests.

A notice based on the reviewed front end. Hosting behavior and future integrations require owner verification before an approved cookie policy is published.

Website notice / draft for owner review

Not an approved policy. This draft records observable website practices and known configuration gaps. The owner must verify deployed behavior and approve any legal commitments.

Observed browser storageGoogle Fonts requestsBrowser controls and downloaded filesOwner verification and future changes

Observed browser storage

No analytics integration or tracking cookie was observed in the current front-end implementation. The selected experience mode is stored in localStorage under cyberhivex-user-mode; enquiry drafts, checklist answers, searches, and demo state are not persisted there.

These observations describe the front end rather than every response issued by the deployed host or contact backend. They are not a guarantee that infrastructure never sets a cookie.

Google Fonts requests

Google Fonts stylesheets and font files are requested from external Google servers. This is an external network request even though no analytics integration was observed.

External servers receive information needed to handle the request, including network and browser headers. External provider behavior and hosting logs are not determined by this front-end code.

Browser controls and downloaded files

You can review site data and request permissions using your browser’s settings. Font requests can be blocked using browser or network controls, which may change typography.

Downloaded enquiry drafts and demo output are ordinary files saved to your device, not cookies. Browser history, autofill, and file retention follow your browser and device settings.

Owner verification and future changes

The owner should review live hosting, CDN responses, any configured contact endpoint, and external-provider behavior. Hosting logs, infrastructure cookie behavior, and retention are currently unverified.

The current front end does not present a cookie consent banner because no nonessential cookie or analytics integration was observed. If such processing is added, its purpose and applicable consent requirements must be reviewed before deployment.
